translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Ikamantakari Lázaro
Eenitatsi apaani mantsiyari atziri jitachari Lázaro, Betania-satzi rini, ari onampitawori janta María eejatzi irento Marta.
(Jiroka María, iritsiro Lázaro, irootake saitantakariri kasankari iitziki Awinkatharite opoña oshetantanaari oishi.)
Okanta apite iritsiro Lázaro, okaimakaantakeri Jesús, okantake: “Pinkatharí, imantsiyatatziira pitsipaminthare.”
Ikanta ikemawake Jesús, ikantzi: “Jiroka mantsiyarentsi te owamaantzi, arira iñagaitero ishintsinka Pawa, ari iñagaitero eejatzi ishintsinka Itomi.”
Ikantawetaka Jesús osheki retakotawo Marta, eejatzi irento, eejatzi Lázaro,
ikemawetaka ikantaitakeri imantsiyatatzi, eekero risaikawaitanaatzi okaatzi apite kiteesheri.
Irojatzi ikantantanaariri riyotaanewo: “Jame apiyai Judea-ki.”
Ari ikantaiyanakeni riyotaanewo: “Rabí, ikowaiyatziinira Judá-ite ritsitokemi. ¿Eejatzi pikowanai pipiyanai janta?”
Ikantanake Jesús: “¿Tema osamani okanta kiteesheri okaatzi 12 hora? Ikaatzi anashitachari kiteesheriki, te rontziwawaita, tema iñaakeri kiteesheenkari jaka kipatsiki.
Iriima anashitachari tsireniriki, rontziwawaita, tema okoityaatya janta kiteesheenkari.”
Eekero ikantanakitzi Jesús: “Makoryaake atsipaminthare Lázaro, iro kantacha ontzimatye niyaate nowiriintairi.”
Ari ikantaiyanakeni riyotaanewo: “Pinkathari, aamaa iro retsiyatakotai, tema rimakoryaatzi.”
Okaatzi ikantawetariri Jesús riyotaanewo rimakoryaatzi, roshiyakaatzi riyotaanewo iro ikenkithatakotzi Jesús makoryagaantsi.
Irojatzi rooñaawontantanakawori, ikantanakeri: “Kamakera Lázaro.
Owanaa nokimoshiretake te nisaiki janta, tema iro pinkemisantaperotantyaari, jame aate amineri.”
Ikanta Tomás iiyeetziri “Tsipari”, ikantanakeri ikaataiyinira: “Jame oyaatanakeri, aminawakero eero rowamagaitai aaka.”
Iri Jesús, owiriintantaneri, añaakaantaneri
Ikanta rareetzimatapaaka Jesús, ikemapaake tzimakotake Lázaro 4 kiteesheri ikitaitantakariri.
Te intainaperote Betania isaikira Jerusalén,
iroowa riyaatashitantakawori Judá-ite jiroka Marta eejatzi María, roimoshirenkantyaawori ikamakera iyaariri.
Okanta iyotake Marta iro rareetzimatya Jesús, jatanake itonkyotyaari. Iroowa saikanaintsiri María pankotsiki.
Okantawakeri Jesús Marta: “Pinkatharí, arime pisaikeme eeroka jaka, eero ikamime aarini.
Iro kantacha niyotzi naaka arika pinkowakoteri Pawa oita rantemiri, ari rimatakemiro.”
Ari rakanakero Jesús: “Aritake rañagai piyaariri.”
Okantzi Marta: “Niyotzi aritake impiriintai paata weyaantapaakyaawone kiteesheri impiriintantaiyaari kamayetatsiri.”
Ikantanakero Jesús: “Naakatake owiriintantatsiri, naakatake añaakaantantaneri. Tzimatsirika kemisantainane naaka, onkantawetya inkame, ari rañagai.
Ikaatzi añaayetatsiri iroñaaka, ikaatzi kemisantainane, eero ikaamaneyetai. ¿Pikemisantziroma jiroka?”
Ari okantziri iroori: “Arima Pinkathari, nokemisantzimi naaka eerokatake Cristo Itomi Pawa, ikowakaakerira ripoke jaka kipatsiki.”
Riraapaaka Jesús ikitaitzirira Lázaro
Ikaatakero Jesús ikantayetakero jiroka, jatanake Marta okaimiro irento María, okamantapaakero, okantziro: “Areetapaaka yotaantaneri, ikaimimi.”
Okanta okemawake María, katziyanaka, pokanake oñeeri Jesús.
Tekera rareetyaata Jesús nampitsiki, irojatzi risaikake itonkyotawakarira Marta.
Okanta iñagaitakero María okatziyanaka ishiyanaka, jirikapaini Judá-ite ikaatzi tsipatakawori opankoki, roimoshirenkiro, royaataiyanakeroni roshiyakaatziiro iraawaitatyeeya kitataarewoki.
Okanta areetapaaka María risaikakera Jesús, otziwerowashitapaakari okantziri: “Pinkatharí, arime pisaikeme eeroka jaka, eero ikamime aari.”
Ikantanakero Jesús, iñaakerowa María irayimotapaakari, ari ikantapaakari eejatzi Judá-ite oyaatapaakerori, antawoite rowashiretanaka, okatsitzimoshiretanakeri,
rosampitanakero: “¿Tsikajaantaka pikitatakerika?” Ari ikantaitanakeri: “Pipokeeta Pinkatharí, piñeeri.”
Ari riraapaakari irirori Jesús.
Irojatzi ikantantanakari Judá-ite: “¡Pamine antawoite retakotari!”
Iro kantacha tzimatsi itsipa kantanaintsiri: “Iriiwetaka jirika etsiyatakotakagairiri mawityaakiri, ¿kaari rantantawo eero ikamanta Lázaro?”
Rañaantaari Lázaro
Apiitanaka Jesús okatsitzimoshiretanakeri, riyaatashitanakeri okaakiini kitataarewoki. Omoonaki ini, mapi rashitakotantaitakari.
Ikantanake Jesús: “Potainkero mapi.” Ari okantanake Marta iritsiro kamaintsiri: “Pinkatharí, aama shitzitake, tema tzimake 4 kiteesheri ikamantakari.”
Rakanakero Jesús: “¿Tema nokantakemi, pinkemisantenarika, arira piñaakero ishintsinka Pawa?”
Rotainkaitakero mapi. Aminanake Jesús inkiteki, ikantanake: “Ashitanari, niwethariimi eeroka, tema pikemana.
Niyotzi ari pikantapiintatya pikemana. Iroowa nokantantari inkemantyaari jirikapaini atziri saikaintsiri jaka, iroowa inkemisantantyaari eerokatake otyaantakenari.”
Okanta okaatapaake ikenkithawaitakero jiroka, ikaimanakeri: “¡Lázaro, pishitowe!”
Shitowapai kaminkari, roosotakawo manthakintsi rakoki eejatzi iitziki, irojatzi iponawootakawo rankowitantaitawakariri ketziroini. Ikantanake Jesús: “Poosoryaakoteri, riyaataita.”
Ikamantawakaita ritsitokakaantaiteri Jesús
Iroowa ikemisantantanakari osheki Judá-ite ikaatzi jatanaintsiri itsipatawo María, ikaatzi ñaakerori rantakeri Jesús.
Iro kantacha eenitatsi jatashitanakeriri Fariseo-paini. Ikamantapaakeri okaatzi rantakeri Jesús.
Ikanta Fariseo-paini itsipatakari reeware Imperatasorentsitaarewo, ipiyotakeri Itzinkamipaini, ikantaiyini: “¿Tsikama ankantyaaka? Jirika atziri osheki ritasonkawentantake.
Arika añaaminthatashitakyaari, arira inkemisantakaakeri maawoini. Ripokake reewarepaini Roma-satzi, itzimpookakaantakero tasorentsipanko, rithonkakaantakero anampipaini.”
Iri kantacha, jirika jitachari Caifás, reewaperore Imperatasorentsitaarewo, ikantanakeri irirori: “Te piyotaiyeni eeroka.
Iri kameethatatsi ashinete apaani atziri inkamawentayetai, iro ompoñaantyaari eero rithonkaitantai anampiki.”
Iri kantacha Caifás, Imperatasorentsiperori, riñaawaitakaanakeri Pawa. Okantawetaka te riyowetawo, iri Jesús ikenkithatakotake inkamawenteri isheninkapaini.
Te apatziro inkamawenteri isheninkapaini inkamawentzityaari maawoini itomipaini Pawa pookayetanaintsiri, ompoñaantyaari riwithaawakaantaiyaari inkaate rashitaiyaari.
Ari ikowaiyanakeni reeware Judá-ite rowamairi Jesús.
Iro kaari ikowantanaa Jesús intsipatanaiyaari Judá-ite. Shitowanake Judea-ki, jatake ochempiki isaikira nampitsi jitachari Efraín. Ari risaikakaapairi riyotaanewo.
Irootzimataatsi roimoshirenkairo Judá-ite Anonkoryagaantsi, osheki atziri jatatsiri Jerusalén-ki riwetsikashiretaiya.
Rithotyaakoitakeri Jesús, rosampitawakaiyani tasorentsipankoki: “¿Tsika pikantaiyinika eeroka? ¿Ari ripokake roimoshirenkaityaaga?”
Ikanta Fariseo-paini itsipayetakari Imperatasorentsiperoriite, ikantantayetake: “Ikaatzi yotatsine tsika risaiki Jesús, inthawete, naakaanteriita.”

footnotes.text: Oshiyakaawentachari jaka “12 hora”, rañaamentowa ini Jesús, iro oshiyakawori apaani kiteesheri. Tema ikenkithawaitakero Jesús jiroka, riyotzi tekera imonkaapaitetaata rowamaantaityaariri. Jiroka ikantakeri: “Pinkenkithashiretakotero oita awisatsiri arika anashitya kiteesheriki. Tema arika anashitya kiteesheriki, kameetha okoñaatzi, eero ontziwawaita, añiiro eejatzi tsika ankene eero aminaashiwaita tsikarika aate. Irooma anashityaarika tsireniriki, osheki ontziwawaitya, aminaashitya tsikarika aate. Iro aatantyaari iroñaaka tsika inintakairo Pawa, eero aminaashiwaita aate. Eerorika aatzi tsikarika ikowakairo Pawa, ari aminaashiwaitakya tsika aate. Tema iri Pawa oshiyawori iroñaaka kiteesheri, tsikarika aate, eero aminashiwaita.”
Kantakotachari jaka “te intainaperote”, iro oshiyawori ikantaitziri iroñaaka 3 kilómetro, irojatzi ikantaitziri pairani 15 estadio.
